questions.content: Let f : N <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.025ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="2.262ex" height="1.181ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -511 1000 522" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="2192" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2192"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> N be a function such that f(m + n) = f(m) + f(n) for every m, n<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.09ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.509ex" height="1.312ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -540 667 580" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="2208" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2208"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>N. If f(6) = 18, then f(2) . f(3) is equal to :
questions.explanation:
f(m + n) = f(m) + f(n)

Put m = 1, n = 1

f(2) = 2f(1)

Put m = 2, n = 1

f(3) = f(2) + f(1) = 3f(1)

Put m = 3, n = 3

f(6) = 2f(3) f(3) = 9

f(1) = 3, f(2) = 6

f(2) . f(3) = 6 9 = 54
